assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: In bug-parsing.md, the '### Environment / Version' section is present (lines 37-39) and contains the vague text: 'Not sure which version -- using whatever is deployed on staging.' The parsing notes on line 52 also confirm: 'Environment / Version: present (but contains vague text, no version identifier)'.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, Step 4.5.2 (lines 9-24) explicitly states: 'Attempted to extract a version identifier (semver pattern, release tag, build number, or other version-like string) from this text. No version pattern could be matched.' It enumerates four extraction attempts (semver, release tag, build number, vague text check) all failing, and concludes: '**Result**: No version identifier could be extracted. Skipping to Step 4.5.6.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, Step 4.5.6 (lines 31-41) contains the comment to post on ACME-511: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description -- please set manually.' This matches the required gap comment text (the double-hyphen '--' is an ASCII representation of the em dash).

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, lines 43-44 contain the Comment Footnote appended to the gap comment: 'This comment was AI-generated by sdlc-workflow/triage-bug v0.13.9.' followed by 'https://github.com/anthropics/sdlc-plugins'. This matches the Comment Footnote template defined in plugins/sdlc-workflow/shared/comment-footnote.md: 'This comment was AI-generated by sdlc-workflow/{skill-name} v{version}.' with skill-name=triage-bug and version=0.13.9, plus the GitHub link.
